answer: The mechanism is a per-identity bond plus a puzzle whose difficulty rises with the number of active seats. Each new seat raises difficulty for everyone, so fake identities get steadily more expensive. A sybil cluster sends a loud echo through the ledger, and every seat funded from the same stake forms a vine pruned at the root when one member is caught: the slash cascades and the bonded stake is lost. The stake is a pulse of collateral validators can freeze mid-epoch. Buying a one-percent share costs far more capital and time than honest work, and refunds arrive only after settlement.
